scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Score only the independently specified final scientific conclusions, totaling 100 points. Each result is pass (full assigned weight), fail (zero), or need_review only where its rubric explicitly permits a concrete unresolved scientific conflict; need_review earns no points and does not establish success. Missing calculations, unsupported guesses, wrong identity/state/environment/reference/units, and values outside a hard numeric window fail. Proven physically equivalent explanations pass directly; a different method is not itself a reason for review. Require actual submitted calculations or executed quantitative analyses and traceable native artifacts appropriate to each claim; copied supplied observations or disclosed targets are not new evidence. Geometry, stationarity, state assignment and model validity qualify their dependent conclusions and earn no separate points. No credit or score gate for workflow, logs, software, calculation counts, chronology or report completeness. Numeric tolerances are fixed and inclusive; contextual numbers without numeric rules are not hidden thresholds. Score each independent result without propagating unrelated failures. Historical verification does not certify this revised V3 rubric or a new blind run.

rules.expected: An executed quantitative observation-model analysis connects the measured temperature/residence-time response to competing availability/generation and loss of capturable species: longer cold residence can increase recoverable product, whereas prolonged warm residence can reduce it with byproduct formation. Explain this relationship using both regimes and the post-MeOH/NH4Cl GC measurement, with correct flow dilution and residence-time conventions. This is a bounded kinetic interpretation, not proof of a unique microscopic network or a direct measurement of intermediate concentration. Observations and supplied maxima alone earn no points. Physically supported equivalent kinetic explanations pass; no fixed five-pool model, RBF implementation or elementary pathway is mandatory for this conclusion.
